def synthesize_project_question(project: Dict[str, Any], role: str, target_diff: str, q_index: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Synthesizes a deep-dive technical question with complete evaluation rubric
    tailored specifically to the candidate's actual resume project.
    """
    title = project.get("title") or project.get("name") or "your featured technical project"
    tech_summary = project.get("tech_summary") or ", ".join(project.get("technologies", [])[:4]) or "the chosen tech stack"
    desc = project.get("description") or ""

    if q_index == 1:
        question = (
            f"In your project '{title}' built with {tech_summary}, what architectural decisions did you make "
            f"during implementation, how did you structure the components and data flow, and what was "
            f"the most critical technical challenge you overcame?"
        )
        expected_answer = (
            f"In {title}, architecting with {tech_summary} requires defining modular service boundaries, "
            f"clean API contracts, and robust error handling. The critical challenge involved balancing implementation "
            f"trade-offs, optimizing data pipelines, and ensuring test coverage across edge cases."
        )
        required_concepts = ["architectural decisions", "component structure", "data flow", "technical challenge", "solution trade-offs"]
        optional_concepts = ["api contracts", "state management", "error handling", "performance bottlenecks"]
        category = "Project Architecture"
    elif q_index == 2:
        question = (
            f"For your project '{title}', walk me through how you handled data persistence, query optimization, "
            f"and error resilience with {tech_summary}. How did you verify that the application performed reliably?"
        )
        expected_answer = (
            f"In {title}, data persistence requires structured schema design, transaction atomicity, and indexing on "
            f"frequently queried fields. Concurrency and resilience are verified using automated unit/integration tests, "
            f"logging, exception handling, and connection pooling."
        )
        required_concepts = ["data persistence", "query optimization", "error resilience", "testing/verification", "indexing or pooling"]
        optional_concepts = ["transactions", "caching", "mocking", "monitoring", "latency"]
        category = "Project Implementation"
    else:
        question = (
            f"Regarding your work on '{title}' ({tech_summary}), what technical trade-off would you reconsider if you were to refactor "
            f"it for high scalability today, and how would you enhance its security and performance?"
        )
        expected_answer = (
            f"Refactoring {title} for higher scale involves introducing asynchronous background processing or caching, "
            f"addressing database bottlenecks, enforcing strict authentication/authorization checks, and establishing CI/CD automation."
        )
        required_concepts = ["trade-off", "refactoring", "scalability", "security", "performance"]
        optional_concepts = ["caching", "async workers", "rate limiting", "load balancing"]
        category = "Project Refactoring"

    return {
        "id": 9000 + q_index,
        "question": question,
        "expected_answer": expected_answer,
        "reference_answer": expected_answer,
        "category": category,
        "topic": f"Project Deep Dive: {title[:30]}",
        "difficulty": target_diff,
        "required_concepts": required_concepts,
        "optional_concepts": optional_concepts,
        "acceptable_alternatives": ["Accept valid technical alternatives implemented by candidate for their specific application domain."],
        "common_misconceptions": [
            "Giving vague buzzwords without specific architectural context from the project",
            "Claiming zero trade-offs or challenges existed"
        ],
        "rubric": {
            "architectural_clarity": 35,
            "technical_depth_and_tradeoffs": 40,
            "concrete_implementation_details": 25
        },
        "follow_up_criteria": "Ask for specific metrics, database schemas, or API status codes used in the project.",
        "targetTime": "60-120 sec",
        "track": f"Project - {title[:20]}"
    }


def normalize_question_tokens(text: str) -> Set[str]:
    """Extract normalized word tokens for duplicate detection."""
    words = re.findall(r'\b[a-zA-Z]{3,}\b', text.lower())
    stop = {"what", "how", "why", "difference", "between", "explain", "describe", "in", "the", "and", "your", "does"}
    return set(w for w in words if w not in stop)


def is_duplicate_question(new_q_text: str, existing_questions: List[Any]) -> bool:
    """Checks if new question is a duplicate or superficial rewording."""
    new_tokens = normalize_question_tokens(new_q_text)
    if not new_tokens:
        return False

    for eq in existing_questions:
        eq_text = eq.get("question", "") if isinstance(eq, dict) else str(eq)
        eq_tokens = normalize_question_tokens(eq_text)
        if not eq_tokens:
            continue
        intersection = len(new_tokens & eq_tokens)
        min_len = min(len(new_tokens), len(eq_tokens))
        if min_len > 0 and (intersection / min_len) >= 0.70:
            return True
    return False


def get_academic_questions_from_db(
    db: Optional[Any] = None,
    count: int = 5,
    role: Optional[str] = None,
    difficulty: Optional[str] = None,
    skills: Optional[Any] = None,
    profile_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Retrieves verified technical interview questions strictly from active academic_train records in MySQL.
    Strictly adheres to Part B Step 3 constraints:
    - Only active academic_train records are eligible (academic_val, academic_test, curated_seed are quarantined).
    - Never generates new questions or calls LLMs/external APIs.
    - Zero random question generation or hardcoded fallback question arrays.
    - Preserves internal traceability to source_dataset and source_id.
    """
    close_db = False
    if db is None:
        db = SessionLocal()
        close_db = True

    try:
        count = max(1, min(int(count or 5), 20))
        
        # Collect keywords for domain-specific matching
        keywords = []
        if skills:
            if isinstance(skills, str):
                keywords.extend([s.strip().lower() for s in skills.split(",") if s.strip()])
            elif isinstance(skills, list):
                keywords.extend([str(s).strip().lower() for s in skills if s])

        if role and isinstance(role, str):
            for word in role.split():
                if len(word) > 3 and word.lower() not in ["developer", "engineer", "software", "senior", "junior"]:
                    keywords.append(word.lower())

        if profile_data:
            parsed = profile_data.get("parsed_resume") or {}
            c_skills = profile_data.get("skills") or parsed.get("skills") or []
            if isinstance(c_skills, str):
                keywords.extend([s.strip().lower() for s in c_skills.split(",") if s.strip()])
            elif isinstance(c_skills, list):
                keywords.extend([str(s).strip().lower() for s in c_skills if s])

            p_role = profile_data.get("target_role")
            if p_role and isinstance(p_role, str):
                for word in p_role.split():
                    if len(word) > 3 and word.lower() not in ["developer", "engineer", "software", "senior", "junior"]:
                        keywords.append(word.lower())

        keywords = list(dict.fromkeys(keywords))  # deduplicate preserving order

        # Strict query: ONLY active academic_train records!
        base_query = db.query(models.Question).filter(
            models.Question.is_active == 1,
            models.Question.source_dataset == "academic_train"
        )

        selected = []
        selected_ids = set()

        if keywords:
            conditions = [models.Question.question_text.ilike(f"%{kw}%") for kw in keywords if len(kw) >= 2]
            if conditions:
                matched = base_query.filter(or_(*conditions)).order_by(models.Question.id.asc()).limit(count).all()
                for q in matched:
                    if q.id not in selected_ids:
                        selected.append(q)
                        selected_ids.add(q.id)

        # Fill remaining slots from active academic_train pool
        if len(selected) < count:
            remaining = count - len(selected)
            filler_query = base_query
            if selected_ids:
                filler_query = filler_query.filter(~models.Question.id.in_(selected_ids))
            fillers = filler_query.order_by(models.Question.id.asc()).limit(remaining).all()
            for q in fillers:
                if q.id not in selected_ids:
                    selected.append(q)
                    selected_ids.add(q.id)

        result_deck = []
        for q in selected:
            concepts = extract_key_concepts(q.reference_answer)
            eval_spec = {
                "expected_answer": q.reference_answer,
                "required_concepts": concepts[:5] if concepts else ["technical explanation", "correct principles"],
                "optional_concepts": concepts[5:10] if len(concepts) > 5 else [],
                "acceptable_alternatives": [],
                "common_misconceptions": [],
                "rubric": {"accuracy": 60, "clarity": 40}
            }

            result_deck.append({
                "id": q.id,
                "question": q.question_text,
                "question_text": q.question_text,
                "source_id": q.source_id,
                "category": q.category or "Academic Technical",
                "difficulty": difficulty or q.difficulty or "Medium",
                "role": role or q.role or "Software Engineer",
                "skill": q.skill or (keywords[0] if keywords else None),
                "source_dataset": q.source_dataset,
                "reference_answer": q.reference_answer,
                "evaluation_spec": eval_spec
            })

        return result_deck
    finally:
        if close_db:
            db.close()


def generate_personalized_questions(
    profile_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    num_questions: int = 5,
    difficulty: Optional[str] = None,
    role: Optional[str] = None,
    experience_level: Optional[str] = None,
    interview_type: Optional[str] = None,
    db: Optional[Any] = None
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Retrieves candidate-specific technical interview deck from active academic_train database records.
    Aligns questions with actual skills, projects, and target role.
    Strictly prohibits LLM generation, random question generation, or hardcoded arrays.
    """
    if not profile_data:
        profile_data = {}

    target_role = role or profile_data.get("target_role") or "Software Engineer"
    target_diff = difficulty or profile_data.get("interview_difficulty") or "Medium"

    return get_academic_questions_from_db(
        db=db,
        count=num_questions,
        role=target_role,
        difficulty=target_diff,
        profile_data=profile_data
    )


def _generate_questions_via_llm(
    target_role: str,
    target_diff: str,
    target_exp: str,
    target_type: str,
    candidate_skills: List[str],
    candidate_projects: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    num_questions: int
) -> Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Generates structured interview questions through the configured LLM provider."""
    prompt = f"""Generate {num_questions} technical interview questions for a {target_exp} candidate interviewing for {target_role}.
Skills: {', '.join(candidate_skills[:8])}
Projects: {json.dumps(candidate_projects[:2])}
Difficulty: {target_diff}
Interview Type: {target_type}

Return JSON with key "questions" containing a list of objects with:
- id: integer
- question: clear technical question
- topic: specific topic
- category: general category
- difficulty: {target_diff}
- expected_answer: reference answer
- reference_answer: same as expected_answer
- required_concepts: list of 4-6 required concepts
- optional_concepts: list of 2-4 optional concepts
- acceptable_alternatives: list of acceptable alternatives
- common_misconceptions: list of 2-3 common misconceptions
- rubric: object with concept_accuracy (30), technical_depth (40), completeness (30)
- targetTime: "45-90 sec"
- track: "{target_role} Track"
"""
    system_prompt = "You are an expert technical interview evaluator. You generate highly specific, verified technical interview questions with strict evaluation rubrics."
    res = llm_provider.generate_json(prompt, system_prompt)
    if res and "questions" in res and isinstance(res["questions"], list):
        return res["questions"]
    return None


def get_interview_questions(db: Optional[Any] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Returns verified academic interview questions from MySQL database."""
    return get_academic_questions_from_db(db=db, count=5)

import math

from pydantic import BaseModel, field_validator, ConfigDict, EmailStr

def sanitize_float(v: Optional[float]) -> Optional[float]:
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (float, int)):
        if math.isnan(v) or math.isinf(v):
            return None
        return float(v)
    return None

import re
import wave
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional


class SpeechAnalyzer:
    """
    Analyzes spoken audio transcripts and timing information from Whisper AI.
    Calculates duration, word count, WPM, filler word breakdown, long pauses,
    speaking fluency, conciseness, and communication score.
    """

    FILLER_PATTERNS = {
        "um": r"\bum\b",
        "uh": r"\buh\b",
        "like": r"\blike\b",
        "you know": r"\byou\s+know\b",
        "basically": r"\bbasically\b",
        "actually": r"\bactually\b"
    }

    def analyze(self, whisper_result: Dict[str, Any], audio_path: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Analyzes Whisper result dict and optional audio file path.
        """
        text = whisper_result.get("text", "").strip() if whisper_result else ""
        segments = whisper_result.get("segments", []) if whisper_result else []

        # Handle empty/no speech transcript
        if not text or len(text.split()) == 0:
            return {
                "duration_seconds": 0.0,
                "word_count": 0,
                "words_per_minute": 0.0,
                "filler_word_count": 0,
                "filler_words": {k: 0 for k in self.FILLER_PATTERNS.keys()},
                "long_pauses_count": 0,
                "fluency_score": 0.0,
                "conciseness_score": 0.0,
                "communication_score": 0.0,
                "status": "no_speech_detected",
                "message": "No speech detected in audio recording."
            }

        # 1. Calculate Speaking Duration
        duration_seconds = None

        if segments and len(segments) > 0:
            start_t = float(segments[0].get("start", 0.0))
            end_t = float(segments[-1].get("end", 0.0))
            if end_t > start_t:
                duration_seconds = round(end_t - start_t, 2)

        if (duration_seconds is None or duration_seconds <= 0) and audio_path:
            try:
                if audio_path.lower().endswith(".wav"):
                    with wave.open(audio_path, "rb") as wf:
                        frames = wf.getnframes()
                        rate = wf.getframerate()
                        duration_seconds = round(frames / float(rate), 2)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 2. Word Count
        words = [w.strip() for w in re.split(r'\s+', text) if w.strip()]
        word_count = len(words)

        # Handle insufficient speech data (< 3 words)
        if word_count < 3:
            return {
                "duration_seconds": duration_seconds,
                "word_count": word_count,
                "words_per_minute": round((word_count / duration_seconds) * 60, 2) if duration_seconds and duration_seconds > 0 else None,
                "filler_word_count": 0,
                "filler_words": {k: 0 for k in self.FILLER_PATTERNS.keys()},
                "long_pauses_count": 0,
                "fluency_score": 20.0,
                "conciseness_score": 20.0,
                "communication_score": 20.0,
                "status": "insufficient_speech_data",
                "message": "Answer too short for reliable speech & fluency analysis."
            }

        # 3. Words Per Minute (WPM)
        if duration_seconds and duration_seconds > 0:
            wpm = round((word_count / duration_seconds) * 60, 2)
        else:
            wpm = None

        # 4. Filler Word Detection
        filler_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
        total_fillers = 0

        for key, pattern in self.FILLER_PATTERNS.items():
            matches = re.findall(pattern, text, re.IGNORECASE)
            count = len(matches)
            filler_counts[key] = count
            total_fillers += count

        # 5. Long Pauses (gap >= 1.5s between consecutive segments)
        long_pauses_count = 0
        if segments and len(segments) > 1:
            for i in range(len(segments) - 1):
                curr_end = float(segments[i].get("end", 0.0))
                next_start = float(segments[i+1].get("start", 0.0))
                if next_start - curr_end >= 1.5:
                    long_pauses_count += 1
        elif not segments:
            long_pauses_count = None

        # 6. Fluency Score (0-100)
        if wpm is not None:
            if 110 <= wpm <= 165:
                base_fluency = 95.0
            elif 80 <= wpm < 110:
                base_fluency = 80.0 + ((wpm - 80) / 30.0) * 15.0
            elif 165 < wpm <= 200:
                base_fluency = 95.0 - ((wpm - 165) / 35.0) * 20.0
            else:
                base_fluency = 60.0
        else:
            base_fluency = 80.0

        # Penalties for fillers and long pauses
        filler_penalty = min(30.0, total_fillers * 4.0)
        pause_penalty = min(20.0, (long_pauses_count or 0) * 5.0)

        fluency_score = round(max(10.0, min(100.0, base_fluency - filler_penalty - pause_penalty)), 2)

        # 7. Conciseness Score (0-100)
        filler_ratio = total_fillers / max(1, word_count)
        conciseness_base = 100.0 - (filler_ratio * 250.0)
        
        if word_count > 250:
            conciseness_base -= min(20.0, (word_count - 250) * 0.1)

        conciseness_score = round(max(10.0, min(100.0, conciseness_base)), 2)

        # 8. Communication Score
        communication_score = round(max(0.0, min(100.0, (0.5 * fluency_score) + (0.5 * conciseness_score))), 2)

        return {
            "duration_seconds": duration_seconds,
            "word_count": word_count,
            "words_per_minute": wpm,
            "filler_word_count": total_fillers,
            "filler_words": filler_counts,
            "long_pauses_count": long_pauses_count,
            "fluency_score": fluency_score,
            "conciseness_score": conciseness_score,
            "communication_score": communication_score,
            "status": "success",
            "message": "Speech analysis completed successfully."
        }

### `backend/app/api/auth.py`
```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from backend.app.database import get_db
from backend.app.models import User
from backend.app.schemas import UserCreate, UserLogin, UserResponse, TokenResponse
from backend.app.auth import hash_password, verify_password, create_access_token, get_current_user

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/auth",
    tags=["Authentication"]
)

@router.post("/register", response_model=TokenResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def register(user_data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    email = user_data.email.strip().lower()
    if not email or "@" not in email:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Please provide a valid email address."
        )
    if not user_data.password or len(user_data.password) < 6:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Password must be at least 6 characters long."
        )

    existing_user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
    if existing_user:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="An account with this email address already exists."
        )

    hashed_pw = hash_password(user_data.password)
    db_user = User(
        email=email,
        hashed_password=hashed_pw,
        full_name=user_data.full_name.strip() if user_data.full_name else None
    )
    db.add(db_user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_user)

    token = create_access_token({"sub": str(db_user.id)})
    return {
        "access_token": token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
        "user": db_user
    }

@router.post("/login", response_model=TokenResponse)
def login(user_data: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    email = user_data.email.strip().lower()
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
    if not user or not verify_password(user_data.password, user.hashed_password):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid email or password.",
            headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
        )

    token = create_access_token({"sub": str(user.id)})
    return {
        "access_token": token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
        "user": user
    }

@router.get("/me", response_model=UserResponse)
def get_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return current_user

@router.post("/logout")
def logout(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return {
        "status": "success",
        "message": "Successfully logged out."
    }
```

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/interviews",
    tags=["Interviews"]
)

@router.post("", response_model=InterviewResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_interview(
    interview_data: InterviewCreate,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """
    Save a completed interview for the authenticated user.
    Preserves actual backend scores and actual input data.
    """
    user_prof = db.query(UserProfile).filter(UserProfile.user_id == current_user.id).first()
    res_filename = interview_data.resume_filename or (user_prof.resume_filename if user_prof else None)
    parsed_res = interview_data.parsed_resume or (user_prof.parsed_resume if user_prof else None)

    db_interview = Interview(
        user_id=current_user.id,
        resume_filename=res_filename,
        parsed_resume=parsed_res,
        target_role=interview_data.target_role or (user_prof.target_role if user_prof else "Software Engineer"),
        experience_level=interview_data.experience_level or (user_prof.experience_type if user_prof else "Mid Level"),
        completed_at=interview_data.completed_at or datetime.utcnow(),
        duration_seconds=interview_data.duration_seconds,
        overall_score=interview_data.overall_score,
        technical_score=interview_data.technical_score or interview_data.overall_score,
        communication_score=interview_data.communication_score,
        questions_answered=interview_data.questions_answered,
        questions_skipped=interview_data.questions_skipped
    )
    db.add(db_interview)
    db.flush()

    for q_data in interview_data.question_results:
        db_question = QuestionResult(
            interview_id=db_interview.id,
            question_number=q_data.question_number,
            question=q_data.question,
            reference_answer=q_data.reference_answer,
            transcript=q_data.transcript,
            final_score=q_data.final_score,
            semantic_similarity=q_data.semantic_similarity,
            relevance_score=q_data.relevance_score,
            concept_coverage=q_data.concept_coverage,
            completeness=q_data.completeness,
            communication_score=q_data.communication_score,
            ai_feedback=q_data.ai_feedback,
            strengths=q_data.strengths,
            areas_for_improvement=q_data.areas_for_improvement,
            speech_analysis=q_data.speech_analysis,
            visual_analysis=q_data.visual_analysis,
            evaluation_spec=q_data.evaluation_spec,
            correct_concepts=q_data.correct_concepts,
            missing_concepts=q_data.missing_concepts,
            incorrect_claims=q_data.incorrect_claims,
            rubric_scores=q_data.rubric_scores,
            attempt_count=q_data.attempt_count or 1
        )
        db.add(db_question)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_interview)
    return db_interview

@router.get("", response_model=List[InterviewResponse])
def get_interviews(
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """
    Fetch interviews belonging to the authenticated user, returning newest first.
    """
    interviews = (
        db.query(Interview)
        .options(joinedload(Interview.question_results))
        .filter(Interview.user_id == current_user.id)
        .order_by(Interview.created_at.desc(), Interview.id.desc())
        .all()
    )
    return interviews

@router.get("/{interview_id}", response_model=InterviewResponse)
def get_interview_by_id(
    interview_id: int,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """
    Fetch a single interview with all question results owned by the authenticated user.
    """
    interview = (
        db.query(Interview)
        .options(joinedload(Interview.question_results))
        .filter(Interview.id == interview_id, Interview.user_id == current_user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not interview:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Interview with id {interview_id} not found."
        )
    return interview

@router.delete("/{interview_id}")
def delete_interview(
    interview_id: int,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    """
    Safely delete an interview owned by the authenticated user.
    """
    interview = (
        db.query(Interview)
        .filter(Interview.id == interview_id, Interview.user_id == current_user.id)
        .first()
    )
    if not interview:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Interview with id {interview_id} not found."
        )

    db.delete(interview)

from typing import Optional
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status, UploadFile, File
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
import os

from backend.app.database import get_db
from backend.app.models import User, UserProfile
from backend.app.schemas import UserProfileUpdate, UserProfileResponse, ResumeUploadResponse
from backend.app.auth import get_current_user, get_current_user_optional
from backend.app.services.resume_parser import (
    parse_resume,
    ALLOWED_RESUME_EXTENSIONS,
    MAX_RESUME_FILE_SIZE_BYTES,
    sanitize_filename
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/profile", tags=["profile"])

@router.get("", response_model=UserProfileResponse)
def get_user_profile(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    """Retrieve current candidate's profile. Creates default profile if missing."""
    profile = db.query(UserProfile).filter(UserProfile.user_id == current_user.id).first()
    
    if not profile:
        profile = UserProfile(
            user_id=current_user.id,
            name=current_user.full_name or current_user.email.split('@')[0],
            education="",
            college="",
            experience_type="Fresher",
            years_of_experience=0.0,
            target_role="Software Engineer",
            skills="Python, JavaScript, SQL",
            programming_languages="Python, JavaScript",
            projects="",
            resume_text="",
            resume_filename=None,
            parsed_resume=None,
            job_description="",
            interview_difficulty="Intermediate"
        )
        db.add(profile)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(profile)
        
    return profile

@router.put("", response_model=UserProfileResponse)
def update_user_profile(
    profile_in: UserProfileUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    """Create or update current candidate's profile."""
    profile = db.query(UserProfile).filter(UserProfile.user_id == current_user.id).first()

    update_data = profile_in.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

    if not profile:
        profile = UserProfile(
            user_id=current_user.id,
            **update_data
        )
        db.add(profile)
    else:
        for field, value in update_data.items():
            setattr(profile, field, value)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(profile)
    return profile


@router.post("/resume", response_model=ResumeUploadResponse)
async def upload_resume(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: Optional[User] = Depends(get_current_user_optional)
):
    """
    Upload and intelligently analyze candidate resume (PDF, DOCX, TXT).
    Extracts skills, projects, experience, education, certifications, and updates candidate profile.
    """
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Filename must not be empty."
        )

    ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename.lower())[1]
    if ext not in ALLOWED_RESUME_EXTENSIONS:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Unsupported file format '{ext}'. Please upload a .pdf, .docx, or .txt file."
        )

    file_bytes = await file.read()
    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_RESUME_FILE_SIZE_BYTES:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Resume file exceeds the maximum 10MB size limit."
        )

    if len(file_bytes) < 15:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Uploaded file is empty or corrupted."
        )

    try:
        parsed_data = parse_resume(file_bytes, file.filename)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail=f"Unable to parse resume: {str(e)}"
        )

    safe_name = sanitize_filename(file.filename)
    skills_str = parsed_data.get("skills_text") or (", ".join(parsed_data["skills"]) if isinstance(parsed_data.get("skills"), list) else str(parsed_data.get("skills") or ""))

    # Persist to database if authenticated
    if current_user:
        profile = db.query(UserProfile).filter(UserProfile.user_id == current_user.id).first()
        if not profile:
            profile = UserProfile(
                user_id=current_user.id,
                name=parsed_data.get("candidate_name") or current_user.full_name or current_user.email.split('@')[0],
                target_role=parsed_data.get("target_role") or "Software Engineer",
                experience_type=parsed_data.get("experience_type") or "Fresher",
                years_of_experience=parsed_data.get("years_of_experience") or 0.0,
                skills=skills_str,
                programming_languages=parsed_data.get("programming_languages"),
                projects=parsed_data.get("projects_summary"),
                education=parsed_data.get("education_summary"),
                resume_text=parsed_data.get("raw_text"),
                resume_filename=safe_name,
                parsed_resume=parsed_data,
                interview_difficulty="Intermediate"
            )
            db.add(profile)
        else:
            if parsed_data.get("candidate_name") and (not profile.name or profile.name == "Candidate"):
                profile.name = parsed_data.get("candidate_name")
            if parsed_data.get("target_role"):
                profile.target_role = parsed_data.get("target_role")
            if skills_str:
                profile.skills = skills_str
            if parsed_data.get("programming_languages"):
                profile.programming_languages = parsed_data.get("programming_languages")
            if parsed_data.get("projects_summary"):
                profile.projects = parsed_data.get("projects_summary")
            if parsed_data.get("education_summary"):
                profile.education = parsed_data.get("education_summary")
            if parsed_data.get("experience_type"):
                profile.experience_type = parsed_data.get("experience_type")
            if parsed_data.get("years_of_experience") is not None:
                profile.years_of_experience = parsed_data.get("years_of_experience")
            profile.resume_text = parsed_data.get("raw_text")
            profile.resume_filename = safe_name
            profile.parsed_resume = parsed_data

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(profile)
    else:
        # Ephemeral profile for guest user
        from datetime import datetime
        profile = UserProfile(
            id=0,
            user_id=0,
            name=parsed_data.get("candidate_name") or "Candidate",
            target_role=parsed_data.get("target_role") or "Software Engineer",
            experience_type=parsed_data.get("experience_type") or "Fresher",
            years_of_experience=parsed_data.get("years_of_experience") or 0.0,
            skills=skills_str,
            programming_languages=parsed_data.get("programming_languages"),
            projects=parsed_data.get("projects_summary"),
            education=parsed_data.get("education_summary"),
            resume_text=parsed_data.get("raw_text"),
            resume_filename=safe_name,
            parsed_resume=parsed_data,
            created_at=datetime.utcnow(),
            updated_at=datetime.utcnow()
        )

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "message": "Resume uploaded and analyzed successfully.",
        "filename": safe_name,
        "char_count": parsed_data.get("char_count", 0),
        "word_count": parsed_data.get("word_count", 0),
        "profile_summary": parsed_data.get("profile_summary", ""),
        "parsed_resume": parsed_data,
        "profile": profile
    }

### `backend/app/services/llm_provider.py`
````python
import os
import json
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class LLMProvider:
    """
    Base Provider abstraction for optional LLM integration (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama, Anthropic).
    Configurable entirely through environment variables.
    If no provider is configured, methods return None so callers cleanly fall back
    to curated verified domain rubrics.
    """
    def __init__(self, name: str = "none"):
        self._name = name

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self._name

    @property
    def provider_name(self) -> str:
        return self._name

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def generate_json(self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str = "") -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return None

    def generate_interview_question(
        self, role: str, skills: List[str], experience_level: str
    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        prompt = f"Role: {role}, Skills: {', '.join(skills)}, Level: {experience_level}"
        data = None
        if hasattr(self, "generate_text"):
            try:
                txt = self.generate_text(prompt)  # type: ignore
                if txt:
                    clean_txt = txt.strip()
                    if clean_txt.startswith("```json"):
                        clean_txt = clean_txt[7:]
                    if clean_txt.startswith("```"):
                        clean_txt = clean_txt[3:]
                    if clean_txt.endswith("```"):
                        clean_txt = clean_txt[:-3]
                    data = json.loads(clean_txt.strip())
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Failed to parse text as json: {e}")
        
        if not data:
            data = self.generate_json(prompt, "You are an expert technical interviewer.")

        if not data or not isinstance(data, dict):
            return None

        # Build standardized question and evaluation_spec
        eval_spec = data.get("evaluation_spec", {})
        if not eval_spec:
            eval_spec = {
                "required_concepts": data.get("required_concepts", []),
                "optional_concepts": data.get("optional_concepts", []),
                "acceptable_alternatives": data.get("acceptable_alternatives", []),
                "common_misconceptions": data.get("common_misconceptions", []),
                "rubric": data.get("rubric", {
                    "concept_accuracy": 40,
                    "technical_depth": 30,
                    "practical_application": 30
                }),
                "follow_up_criteria": data.get("follow_up_criteria", "")
            }

        return {
            "question": data.get("question", ""),
            "category": data.get("category", role),
            "difficulty": data.get("difficulty", "Medium"),
            "expected_answer": data.get("expected_answer", ""),
            "evaluation_spec": eval_spec
        }


class GeminiProvider(LLMProvider):
    def __init__(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model_name: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__(name="gemini")
        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", "").strip()
        self.model_name = model_name or os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "").strip() or "gemini-1.5-flash"

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.api_key)

    def generate_json(self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str = "") -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if not self.is_available():
            return None
        url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{self.model_name}:generateContent?key={self.api_key}"
        payload = {
            "contents": [
                {
                    "parts": [
                        {"text": f"{system_prompt}\n\n{prompt}" if system_prompt else prompt}
                    ]
                }
            ],
            "generationConfig": {
                "temperature": 0.2,
                "responseMimeType": "application/json"
            }
        }
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                url,
                data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                method="POST"
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
                data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                candidates = data.get("candidates", [])
                if candidates:
                    text = candidates[0].get("content", {}).get("parts", [{}])[0].get("text", "")
                    return json.loads(text)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Gemini generation call failed: {e}")
        return None


class OpenAIProvider(LLMProvider):
    def __init__(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model_name: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__(name="openai")
        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "").strip()
        self.model_name = model_name or os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "").strip() or "gpt-4o-mini"

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.api_key)

    def generate_json(self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str = "") -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if not self.is_available():
            return None
        url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
        messages = []
        if system_prompt:
            messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})

        payload = {
            "model": self.model_name,
            "messages": messages,
            "temperature": 0.2,
            "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}
        }
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                url,
                data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
                headers={
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}"
                },
                method="POST"
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
                data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                choices = data.get("choices", [])
                if choices:
                    text = choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "")
                    return json.loads(text)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"OpenAI generation call failed: {e}")
        return None


class OllamaProvider(LLMProvider):
    def __init__(self, base_url: Optional[str] = None, model_name: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__(name="ollama")
        self.base_url = (base_url or os.getenv("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "").strip()).rstrip("/")
        self.model_name = model_name or os.getenv("LLM_MODEL", "").strip() or "llama3.2"

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.base_url)

    def generate_json(self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str = "") -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        if not self.is_available():
            return None
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/generate"
        payload = {
            "model": self.model_name,
            "prompt": f"{system_prompt}\n\n{prompt}" if system_prompt else prompt,
            "format": "json",
            "stream": False
        }
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                url,
                data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
                headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                method="POST"
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as resp:
                data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
                response_text = data.get("response", "")
                return json.loads(response_text)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Ollama generation call failed: {e}")
        return None


def get_configured_llm_provider() -> Optional[LLMProvider]:
    """
    Instantiates and returns the configured provider based on environment variables,
    or None if no supported provider is configured.
    """
    explicit = os.getenv("LLM_PROVIDER", "").strip().lower()
    gemini_key = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", "").strip()
    openai_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "").strip()
    ollama_url = os.getenv("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "").strip()

    if explicit == "gemini" and gemini_key:
        return GeminiProvider(api_key=gemini_key)
    if explicit == "openai" and openai_key:
        return OpenAIProvider(api_key=openai_key)
    if explicit == "ollama" and ollama_url:
        return OllamaProvider(base_url=ollama_url)

    # Auto-detection
    if gemini_key:
        return GeminiProvider(api_key=gemini_key)
    if openai_key:
        return OpenAIProvider(api_key=openai_key)
    if ollama_url:
        return OllamaProvider(base_url=ollama_url)

    return None


class DynamicLLMProxy:
    """
    Transparent proxy that dynamically dispatches to whichever provider is currently
    configured in the environment. Defaults safely to no-op when unconfigured.
    """
    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        provider = get_configured_llm_provider()
        return provider is not None and provider.is_available()

    @property
    def provider_name(self) -> str:
        provider = get_configured_llm_provider()
        return provider.name if provider else "none"

    def generate_json(self, prompt: str, system_prompt: str = "") -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        provider = get_configured_llm_provider()
        if provider:
            return provider.generate_json(prompt, system_prompt)
        return None

    def generate_interview_question(
        self, role: str, skills: List[str], experience_level: str
    ) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        provider = get_configured_llm_provider()
        if provider:
            return provider.generate_interview_question(role, skills, experience_level)
        return None


# Global active instance
llm_provider = DynamicLLMProxy()
````

import os
import sys
import html
from typing import Dict, Any

# Ensure GTK3 DLL directory is configured for Windows WeasyPrint loading
gtk_candidate_dirs = [
    r"C:\Users\Sumit\GTK3-Runtime\bin",
    r"C:\Program Files\GTK3-Runtime Win64\bin",
    os.environ.get("GTK_PATH", "")
]
for gtk_dir in gtk_candidate_dirs:
    if gtk_dir and os.path.exists(gtk_dir):
        try:
            os.add_dll_directory(gtk_dir)
        except (AttributeError, OSError):
            pass
        if gtk_dir not in os.environ.get("PATH", ""):
            os.environ["PATH"] = gtk_dir + ";" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")

# Import WeasyPrint after setting up DLL directory
try:
    import weasyprint
except Exception as e:
    weasyprint = None
    _WEASYPRINT_IMPORT_ERROR = str(e)


def render_weasyprint_pdf(report: Dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
    """
    Renders an executive, publication-grade PDF report using WeasyPrint.
    Ensures strict WeasyPrint CSS compatibility (@page, page-break-inside, clean tables).
    """
    if weasyprint is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"WeasyPrint is not properly configured on this system: {_WEASYPRINT_IMPORT_ERROR}")

    candidate = report.get("candidate", {})
    interview_sum = report.get("interview_summary", {})
    performance = report.get("performance_analysis", {})
    resume_analysis = report.get("resume_analysis", {})
    topics = report.get("topic_breakdown", [])
    questions = report.get("question_wise_analysis", [])
    strengths = report.get("strengths", [])
    weaknesses = report.get("areas_for_improvement", [])
    recommendations = report.get("actionable_recommendations", [])

    # Escape HTML to prevent injection
    cand_name = html.escape(str(candidate.get("name", "Candidate")))
    cand_role = html.escape(str(candidate.get("target_role", "Software Engineer")))
    cand_email = html.escape(str(candidate.get("email", "Not Provided")))
    report_id = html.escape(str(candidate.get("session_id", "INT-2026-LIVE")))
    interview_date = html.escape(str(candidate.get("interview_date", "Recent Session")))
    resume_file = html.escape(str(candidate.get("resume_filename", "Uploaded Resume")))

    overall_score = float(interview_sum.get("overall_score", 0.0))
    hiring_verdict = html.escape(str(interview_sum.get("hiring_verdict", "COMPLETED")))
    verdict_color = interview_sum.get("verdict_color", "#6366f1")

    # Render Skills Badges HTML
    skills_html_parts = []
    cat_skills = resume_analysis.get("categorized_skills", {})
    if cat_skills:
        for cat_name, skill_list in cat_skills.items():
            if skill_list:
                pills = "".join(f'<span class="skill-pill">{html.escape(s)}</span>' for s in skill_list[:12])
                skills_html_parts.append(f"""
                <div class="skill-cat-row">
                    <span class="skill-cat-label">{html.escape(cat_name)}:</span>
                    <div class="skill-pill-container">{pills}</div>
                </div>
                """)
    elif resume_analysis.get("all_skills"):
        pills = "".join(f'<span class="skill-pill">{html.escape(s)}</span>' for s in resume_analysis["all_skills"][:20])
        skills_html_parts.append(f'<div class="skill-pill-container">{pills}</div>')
    else:
        skills_html_parts.append('<p class="muted-text">Standard technical profile competencies</p>')
    skills_block_html = "".join(skills_html_parts)

    # Render Projects HTML
    projects_html_parts = []
    projects_list = resume_analysis.get("projects", [])
    if projects_list:
        for p in projects_list[:3]:
            p_title = html.escape(str(p.get("title", "Project")))
            p_tech = html.escape(str(p.get("tech_summary", "")))
            p_desc = html.escape(str(p.get("description", "")))
            projects_html_parts.append(f"""
            <div class="project-mini-card">
                <div class="pmc-header">
                    <strong>{p_title}</strong>
                    <span class="pmc-tech font-mono">{p_tech}</span>
                </div>
                <p class="pmc-desc">{p_desc if p_desc else 'Technical project implementation'}</p>
            </div>
            """)
    else:
        projects_html_parts.append('<p class="muted-text">General engineering implementation history</p>')
    projects_block_html = "".join(projects_html_parts)

    # Render Question Evaluations HTML
    questions_html_parts = []
    for q in questions:
        q_num = q.get("question_number", 1)
        q_text = html.escape(str(q.get("question", "")))
        q_score = float(q.get("score", 0.0))
        q_ans = html.escape(str(q.get("candidate_answer", "")))
        q_cat = html.escape(str(q.get("category", "Technical")))
        q_feed = html.escape(str(q.get("ai_feedback", "")))

        score_badge_class = "score-high" if q_score >= 70.0 else ("score-mid" if q_score >= 50.0 else "score-low")

        # Question strengths and improvements
        q_str_html = "".join(f"<li>{html.escape(s)}</li>" for s in q.get("strengths", [])[:3])
        q_imp_html = "".join(f"<li>{html.escape(w)}</li>" for s in q.get("areas_for_improvement", []) for w in [s][:3])

        correct_concepts = q.get("correct_concepts", [])
        missing_concepts = q.get("missing_concepts", [])
        incorrect_claims = q.get("incorrect_claims", [])
        q_explanation = q.get("explanation") or q_feed

        speech_info = q.get("speech_analysis") or {}
        wpm_val = speech_info.get("words_per_minute")
        wpm_str = f"{int(wpm_val)} WPM" if wpm_val else "Normal pace"
        fillers_val = speech_info.get("filler_word_count")
        fillers_str = f"{fillers_val} fillers" if (fillers_val is not None and fillers_val > 0) else "Clear speech"

        correct_pills = "".join(f'<span class="concept-pill concept-correct">✓ {html.escape(c)}</span>' for c in correct_concepts) if correct_concepts else '<span class="muted-text font-sm">No specific required keywords matched</span>'
        missing_pills = "".join(f'<span class="concept-pill concept-missing">✗ {html.escape(m)}</span>' for m in missing_concepts) if missing_concepts else '<span class="muted-text font-sm">None missing</span>'
        incorrect_html = f'<div class="concept-row text-danger"><span class="concept-label">Identified Misconceptions:</span> ' + "".join(f'<span class="concept-pill concept-incorrect">⚠ {html.escape(w)}</span>' for w in incorrect_claims) + '</div>' if incorrect_claims else ""

        questions_html_parts.append(f"""
        <div class="question-eval-card">
            <div class="qec-header">
                <div class="qec-meta">
                    <span class="qec-badge">QUESTION {q_num:02d}</span>
                    <span class="qec-category">{q_cat}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="qec-score {score_badge_class} font-mono">
                    Score: {q_score:.1f}%
                </div>
            </div>
            <h4 class="qec-question">{q_text}</h4>

            <div class="qec-answer-box">
                <span class="qec-sublabel">Candidate Final Submitted Answer:</span>
                <p class="qec-transcript">"{q_ans if q_ans else 'No answer recorded.'}"</p>
                <div class="qec-speech-tags">
                    <span class="speech-tag">Pace: {wpm_str}</span>
                    <span class="speech-tag">Clarity: {fillers_str}</span>
                    <span class="speech-tag">Relevance: {q.get('relevance_score', 0):.1f}%</span>
                    <span class="speech-tag">Coverage: {q.get('completeness', 0):.1f}%</span>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="qec-concepts-box">
                <div class="concept-row">
                    <span class="concept-label">Concepts Mastered:</span>
                    {correct_pills}
                </div>
                <div class="concept-row">
                    <span class="concept-label">Missing / Incomplete:</span>
                    {missing_pills}
                </div>
                {incorrect_html}
            </div>

            <div class="qec-feedback-box">
                <div class="feedback-title">Evaluation Explanation & Scoring Rubric:</div>
                <p class="feedback-text">{html.escape(q_explanation)}</p>
            </div>

            <div class="qec-points-grid">
                <div class="qec-point-col strengths-col">
                    <div class="point-col-header text-success">Key Strengths</div>
                    <ul>{q_str_html if q_str_html else '<li>Addressed the core subject of the question.</li>'}</ul>
                </div>
                <div class="qec-point-col improvements-col">
                    <div class="point-col-header text-warning">Suggested Learning Guidance</div>
                    <ul>{q_imp_html if q_imp_html else '<li>Elaborate further with concrete production examples.</li>'}</ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        """)
    questions_block_html = "".join(questions_html_parts)

    # Render Topic Breakdown Rows
    topic_rows_html = "".join(f"""
    <tr>
        <td><strong>{html.escape(t['topic'])}</strong></td>
        <td>{t['questions_count']} Question(s)</td>
        <td class="font-mono text-right" style="color: {'#10b981' if t['score']>=70 else ('#6366f1' if t['score']>=50 else '#ef4444')}; font-weight: 700;">
            {t['score']:.1f}%
        </td>
    </tr>
    """ for t in topics)

    # Render Strengths & Improvements Lists
    strengths_html = "".join(f"<li>{html.escape(s)}</li>" for s in strengths)
    weaknesses_html = "".join(f"<li>{html.escape(w)}</li>" for w in weaknesses)
    recommendations_html = "".join(f"<li>{html.escape(r)}</li>" for r in recommendations)
    exec_summary_html = html.escape(str(report.get("executive_summary", "")))

    html_content = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>AI Interview Assessment Report - {cand_name}</title>
    <style>
        /* ==========================================
           WEASYPRINT PRINT STYLESHEET
           ========================================== */
        @page {{
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 16mm 14mm 16mm 14mm;
            @top-left {{
                content: "AI INTERVIEW ANALYZER — OFFICIAL ASSESSMENT";
                font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
                font-size: 7pt;
                font-weight: 700;
                color: #64748b;
                letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            }}
            @top-right {{
                content: "CONFIDENTIAL CANDIDATE REPORT";
                font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
                font-size: 7pt;
                color: #94a3b8;
                letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            }}
            @bottom-left {{
                content: "Generated by AI Interview Analyzer Platform";
                font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
                font-size: 7pt;
                color: #64748b;
            }}
            @bottom-right {{
                content: "Page " counter(page) " of " counter(pages);
                font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
                font-size: 7pt;
                font-weight: 700;
                color: #475569;
            }}
        }}

        body {{
            font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            color: #0f172a;
            background-color: #ffffff;
            line-height: 1.45;
            font-size: 9pt;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }}

        .font-mono {{
            font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
        }}

        .text-right {{
            text-align: right;
        }}

        .page-break {{
            page-break-before: always;
        }}

        .no-break {{
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        /* Header Banner */
        .executive-header {{
            border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
            padding-bottom: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }}

        .eh-table {{
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }}

        .eh-title-row td {{
            vertical-align: middle;
        }}

        .brand-logo-badge {{
            display: inline-block;
            background: #0f172a;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 8pt;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }}

        .candidate-title {{
            font-size: 18pt;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #0f172a;
            margin: 2px 0 4px 0;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }}

        .candidate-meta-line {{
            font-size: 8.5pt;
            color: #475569;
        }}

        .verdict-box {{
            text-align: right;
        }}

        .verdict-tag {{
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 9.5pt;
            font-weight: 800;
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            color: #ffffff;
            background-color: {verdict_color};
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }}

        .report-meta-text {{
            font-size: 7.5pt;
            color: #64748b;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }}

        /* Section Headings */
        .section-heading {{
            font-size: 11pt;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #0f172a;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            border-left: 3px solid #6366f1;
            padding-left: 8px;
            margin-top: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }}

        /* Hero Performance Cards */
        .hero-stats-table {{
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 8px;
            margin-left: -8px;
            margin-right: -8px;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        .hero-stat-cell {{
            background: #f8fafc;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 12px;
            text-align: center;
            width: 25%;
        }}

        .hero-score-cell {{
            background: #f1f5f9;
            border: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1;
        }}

        .hsc-label {{
            font-size: 7.5pt;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: #64748b;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }}

        .hsc-value {{
            font-size: 18pt;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #0f172a;
            display: block;
        }}

        .hsc-sub {{
            font-size: 7pt;
            color: #94a3b8;
        }}

        /* Executive Verdict Banner */
        .verdict-banner {{
            background: #f8fafc;
            border-left: 4px solid #6366f1;
            border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        .vb-title {{
            font-size: 8.5pt;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #1e293b;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }}

        .vb-text {{
            font-size: 8.5pt;
            color: #475569;
            margin: 0;
        }}

        /* 4-Dimension Metric Bars */
        .metric-table {{
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        .metric-table th {{
            font-size: 7.5pt;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: #64748b;
            border-bottom: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1;
            padding: 6px 8px;
            text-align: left;
        }}

        .metric-table td {{
            font-size: 8.5pt;
            padding: 7px 8px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
        }}

        .bar-container {{
            width: 100%;
            background: #e2e8f0;
            height: 7px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: inline-block;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }}

        .bar-fill {{
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }}

        /* Resume Analysis */
        .resume-summary-card {{
            background: #f8fafc;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        .skill-cat-row {{
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }}

        .skill-cat-label {{
            font-size: 8pt;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #334155;
            display: inline-block;
            width: 175px;
            vertical-align: top;
        }}

        .skill-pill-container {{
            display: inline-block;
            width: calc(100% - 185px);
        }}

        .skill-pill {{
            display: inline-block;
            background: #eef2ff;
            color: #4338ca;
            border: 1px solid #c7d2fe;
            font-size: 7.5pt;
            padding: 1.5px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-right: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }}

        .project-mini-card {{
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        .pmc-header {{
            font-size: 8.5pt;
            color: #0f172a;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }}

        .pmc-tech {{
            font-size: 7pt;
            color: #6366f1;
            margin-left: 8px;
        }}

        .pmc-desc {{
            font-size: 8pt;
            color: #475569;
            margin: 0;
        }}

        /* Question Evaluation Cards */
        .question-eval-card {{
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        .qec-header {{
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }}

        .qec-badge {{
            font-size: 7pt;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: #0f172a;
            color: #ffffff;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            margin-right: 6px;
        }}

        .qec-category {{
            font-size: 7.5pt;
            color: #6366f1;
            font-weight: 600;
        }}

        .qec-score {{
            float: right;
            font-size: 8.5pt;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }}

        .score-high {{
            background: #ecfdf5;
            color: #047857;
            border: 1px solid #a7f3d0;
        }}

        .score-mid {{
            background: #eef2ff;
            color: #4338ca;
            border: 1px solid #c7d2fe;
        }}

        .score-low {{
            background: #fff1f2;
            color: #be123c;
            border: 1px solid #fecdd3;
        }}

        .qec-question {{
            font-size: 9pt;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #0f172a;
            margin: 4px 0 8px 0;
            clear: both;
        }}

        .qec-answer-box {{
            background: #f8fafc;
            border-left: 3px solid #cbd5e1;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }}

        .qec-sublabel {{
            font-size: 7pt;
            color: #64748b;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-weight: 700;
            display: block;
        }}

        .qec-transcript {{
            font-size: 8pt;
            font-style: italic;
            color: #334155;
            margin: 3px 0 4px 0;
        }}

        .qec-speech-tags {{
            font-size: 7pt;
            color: #64748b;
        }}

        .speech-tag {{
            display: inline-block;
            background: #e2e8f0;
            padding: 1px 5px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            margin-right: 4px;
        }}

        .qec-concepts-box {{
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }}

        .concept-row {{
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            font-size: 7.5pt;
        }}

        .concept-label {{
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #334155;
            display: inline-block;
            min-width: 110px;
        }}

        .concept-pill {{
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 6.8pt;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 1px 6px;
            border-radius: 3px;
            margin-right: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }}

        .concept-correct {{
            background: #ecfdf5;
            color: #047857;
            border: 1px solid #a7f3d0;
        }}

        .concept-missing {{
            background: #fff7ed;
            color: #c2410c;
            border: 1px solid #fed7aa;
        }}

        .concept-incorrect {{
            background: #fff1f2;
            color: #b91c1c;
            border: 1px solid #fecdd3;
        }}

        .qec-feedback-box {{
            background: #fdf4ff;
            border: 1px solid #f0abfc;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }}

        .feedback-title {{
            font-size: 7.5pt;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #86198f;
        }}

        .feedback-text {{
            font-size: 8pt;
            color: #701a75;
            margin: 2px 0 0 0;
        }}

        .qec-points-grid {{
            width: 100%;
        }}

        .qec-point-col {{
            display: inline-block;
            width: 48%;
            vertical-align: top;
            font-size: 7.5pt;
        }}

        .qec-point-col ul {{
            margin: 3px 0 0 0;
            padding-left: 14px;
            color: #475569;
        }}

        .point-col-header {{
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            font-size: 7pt;
        }}

        .text-success {{
            color: #059669;
        }}

        .text-warning {{
            color: #d97706;
        }}

        /* Final Recommendations Section */
        .final-grid {{
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 10px;
            margin-left: -10px;
            margin-right: -10px;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
        }}

        .final-card {{
            background: #f8fafc;
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 14px;
            vertical-align: top;
            width: 50%;
        }}

        .final-card h4 {{
            margin: 0 0 6px 0;
            font-size: 8.5pt;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: #1e293b;
        }}

        .final-card ul {{
            margin: 0;
            padding-left: 16px;
            font-size: 8pt;
            color: #475569;
        }}

        .final-card li {{
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }}

        .muted-text {{
            font-size: 8pt;
            color: #94a3b8;
            font-style: italic;
        }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <!-- PAGE 1: EXECUTIVE ASSESSMENT COVER & SUMMARY -->
    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <div class="executive-header">
        <table class="eh-table">
            <tr class="eh-title-row">
                <td style="width: 65%;">
                    <span class="brand-logo-badge">AI INTERVIEW ANALYZER</span>
                    <h1 class="candidate-title">{cand_name}</h1>
                    <div class="candidate-meta-line">
                        <strong>Target Role:</strong> {cand_role} &nbsp;·&nbsp;
                        <strong>Email:</strong> {cand_email} &nbsp;·&nbsp;
                        <strong>Date:</strong> {interview_date}
                    </div>
                    <div class="candidate-meta-line" style="margin-top: 2px;">
                        <strong>Resume File:</strong> {resume_file} &nbsp;·&nbsp;
                        <strong>Report ID:</strong> <span class="font-mono">{report_id}</span>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td style="width: 35%;" class="verdict-box">
                    <span class="verdict-tag">{hiring_verdict}</span>
                    <div class="report-meta-text">Platform AI Verification #INT-{report_id[-6:]}</div>
                </td>
            </tr>
        </table>
    </div>

    <!-- 4 HERO SUMMARY TILES -->
    <table class="hero-stats-table">
        <tr>
            <td class="hero-stat-cell hero-score-cell">
                <span class="hsc-label">Overall Performance</span>
                <span class="hsc-value font-mono" style="color: {verdict_color};">{overall_score:.1f}%</span>
                <span class="hsc-sub">Weighted Evaluation Index</span>
            </td>
            <td class="hero-stat-cell">
                <span class="hsc-label">Questions Evaluated</span>
                <span class="hsc-value font-mono">{interview_sum.get('questions_answered', 0)} / {interview_sum.get('total_questions', 0)}</span>
                <span class="hsc-sub">{interview_sum.get('questions_skipped', 0)} Question(s) Skipped</span>
            </td>
            <td class="hero-stat-cell">
                <span class="hsc-label">Session Duration</span>
                <span class="hsc-value font-mono">{interview_sum.get('duration_formatted', '0m 0s')}</span>
                <span class="hsc-sub">Active Recording Time</span>
            </td>
            <td class="hero-stat-cell">
                <span class="hsc-label">Communication Pace</span>
                <span class="hsc-value font-mono">{performance.get('communication_fluency', 0):.1f}%</span>
                <span class="hsc-sub">Speech & Articulation</span>
            </td>
        </tr>
    </table>

    <!-- EXECUTIVE SUMMARY BANNER -->
    <div class="verdict-banner">
        <div class="vb-title">EXECUTIVE CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW</div>
        <p class="vb-text">{exec_summary_html}</p>
    </div>

    <!-- 4-DIMENSION PERFORMANCE BREAKDOWN -->
    <div class="section-heading">Core Performance Matrix</div>
    <table class="metric-table">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th style="width: 25%;">Evaluation Pillar</th>
                <th style="width: 50%;">Proficiency Index</th>
                <th style="width: 15%; text-align: right;">Score</th>
                <th style="width: 10%; text-align: right;">Weight</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            <tr>
                <td><strong>Technical Mastery</strong></td>
                <td>
                    <div class="bar-container"><div class="bar-fill" style="width: {performance.get('technical_mastery', 0)}%; background: #6366f1;"></div></div>
                </td>
                <td class="font-mono text-right">{performance.get('technical_mastery', 0):.1f}%</td>
                <td class="text-right muted-text">35%</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td><strong>Answer Relevance</strong></td>
                <td>
                    <div class="bar-container"><div class="bar-fill" style="width: {performance.get('answer_relevance', 0)}%; background: #06b6d4;"></div></div>
                </td>
                <td class="font-mono text-right">{performance.get('answer_relevance', 0):.1f}%</td>
                <td class="text-right muted-text">25%</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td><strong>Answer Completeness</strong></td>
                <td>
                    <div class="bar-container"><div class="bar-fill" style="width: {performance.get('answer_completeness', 0)}%; background: #8b5cf6;"></div></div>
                </td>
                <td class="font-mono text-right">{performance.get('answer_completeness', 0):.1f}%</td>
                <td class="text-right muted-text">20%</td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
                <td><strong>Communication & Fluency</strong></td>
                <td>
                    <div class="bar-container"><div class="bar-fill" style="width: {performance.get('communication_fluency', 0)}%; background: #10b981;"></div></div>
                </td>
                <td class="font-mono text-right">{performance.get('communication_fluency', 0):.1f}%</td>
                <td class="text-right muted-text">20%</td>
            </tr>
        </tbody>
    </table>

    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <!-- PAGE 2: RESUME ANALYSIS & TECHNICAL PROFILE -->
    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <div class="page-break"></div>

    <div class="section-heading">Resume Analysis & Candidate Profile</div>
    <div class="resume-summary-card">
        <p style="margin: 0 0 10px 0; font-size: 8.5pt; color: #334155;">
            {html.escape(str(resume_analysis.get('summary', '')))}
        </p>
        <div style="border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 8px;">
            {skills_block_html}
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- DETECTED PROJECTS -->
    <div class="section-heading">Detected Technical Projects</div>
    {projects_block_html}

    <!-- TOPIC COVERAGE TABLE -->
    <div class="section-heading" style="margin-top: 16px;">Topic Performance Breakdown</div>
    <table class="metric-table">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th>Evaluated Topic</th>
                <th>Question Count</th>
                <th style="text-align: right;">Average Score</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
            {topic_rows_html if topic_rows_html else '<tr><td colspan="3" class="muted-text">Standard core topics evaluated</td></tr>'}
        </tbody>
    </table>

    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <!-- PAGE 3+: QUESTION-BY-QUESTION DETAILED EVALUATION -->
    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <div class="page-break"></div>

    <div class="section-heading">Question-by-Question Detailed Analysis</div>
    <p style="font-size: 8pt; color: #64748b; margin-top: -6px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
        Evaluated against expected technical keywords, architectural depth, communication fluency, and reference answers.
    </p>

    {questions_block_html}

    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <!-- FINAL SECTION: STRENGTHS, IMPROVEMENTS & ROADMAP -->
    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <div class="section-heading" style="margin-top: 20px;">Comprehensive Preparation Roadmap</div>

    <table class="final-grid">
        <tr>
            <td class="final-card" style="border-left: 3px solid #10b981;">
                <h4 style="color: #047857;">Demonstrated Strengths</h4>
                <ul>{strengths_html}</ul>
            </td>
            <td class="final-card" style="border-left: 3px solid #f59e0b;">
                <h4 style="color: #b45309;">Priority Areas for Improvement</h4>
                <ul>{weaknesses_html}</ul>
            </td>
        </tr>
    </table>

    <div class="final-card" style="width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 10px; border-left: 3px solid #6366f1;">
        <h4 style="color: #4338ca;">Recommended Next Preparation Steps</h4>
        <ul>{recommendations_html}</ul>
    </div>

</body>
</html>
"""

    # Generate PDF with WeasyPrint
    pdf_bytes = weasyprint.HTML(string=html_content).write_pdf()
    return pdf_bytes
